_comment.baudrate: Serial baudrate. Recommended: 115200 for low latency
_comment.block_original_input: Block original keyboard input (only forward via Arduino). true = block, false = allow both
_comment.forwarding_enabled: Enable forwarding to Arduino. true = forward, false = only block
_comment.stuck_key_timeout: Auto-release stuck keys after timeout (seconds). Recommended: 10.0
_comment.enable_logging: Enable debug logging. true = verbose logs, false = minimal
